Base Set.info: Base Set is the name given to the first main expansion of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. In Japan, it was released as Expansion Pack, the first expansion in the Pokémon Card Game. It is based on Pokémon Red, Blue, and Green, featuring Generation I Pokémon. The English expansion was released on January 9, 1999, while the Japanese expansion was released on October 20, 1996. Although not part of the TCG, Bandai Pokémon Cards Part 1 Green & Part 2 Red (September 1996) is regarded as pre-dating the Japanese Base set, and therefore is the oldest known Pokémon Card release.

Jungle.title_jp: ポケモンジャングル / Pokémon Jungle
Jungle.info: Jungle is the name given to the second main expansion of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. In Japan, it was released as Pokémon Jungle, the second expansion in the Pokémon Card Game. It is based on Pokémon Red, Blue, and Green, featuring Generation I Pokémon, and is said to take place in the Kanto Safari Zone. The English expansion was released on June 16, 1999, while the Japanese expansion was released on March 5, 1997. Subsequently all other language releases for Jungle were February of 2000. The Japanese release contained 48 cards; however, the English release was expanded to 64 cards since Wizards of the Coast decided to include Non Holofoil prints of the Rare Holo cards. This is to make the expansion larger, as well as preventing packs from guaranteeing a Holofoil card. The 1st Edition print run also accidentally included the extremely rare 1st Edition Promo Pikachu. In the Australian release, the Unlimited print used red lettering for the word Pokémon instead of yellow on relevant packaging. This was to help prevent counterfeiting.

Fossil.title_jp: 化石の秘密 / Mystery of the Fossils
Fossil.info: Fossil is the name given to the third main expansion of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. In Japan, it was released as Mystery of the Fossils, the third expansion in the Pokémon Card Game. It is based on Pokémon Red, Blue, and Green, featuring Generation I Pokémon and Fossil Pokémon. The English expansion was released on October 10, 1999, while the Japanese expansion was released on June 21, 1997. Fossil was the final expansion to use the Starlight Holofoil.

Base Set 2.name: Base Set 2
Base Set 2.info: Base Set 2 is the fourth main expansion of the Pokémon Trading Card Game, released on February 24, 2000. It has no Japanese equivalent and is composed of reprints from the Base Set and Jungle expansions. It was the first English expansion to use the Cosmos Holofoil. Some cards from Base Set and Jungle were omitted or merged.

Yu-Gi-Oh! Trading Card Game - Series 1.info: Vol.1, short for Volume 1, is a Booster Pack that was released on February 4, 1999 as the first set in the Yu-Gi-Oh! Official Card Game. Like all Series 1 sets, Vol.1 cards used the Series 1 card layout, distinguished from later layouts by the lack of a Card Number beneath the card's artwork and the Eye of Anubis Hologram in its lower-right corner. This legendary first set features iconic cards like Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Dark Magician.
Yu-Gi-Oh! Trading Card Game - Series 1.special_features: Series 1 Card Layout - Eye of Anubis Hologram - Historic First Set

Booster1.title_jp: 遊戯王OCG ブースター1
Booster1.info: Booster 1 was released on March 1, 1999 as one of the very first Booster Packs in the Yu-Gi-Oh! Official Card Game—preceded only by Vol.1, which was released the month prior. Like all Series 1 sets, Booster 1 cards used the Series 1 card layout, distinguished from later layouts by the lack of a Card Number beneath the card's artwork and the Eye of Anubis Hologram in its lower-right corner.
Booster1.special_features: Series 1 Card Layout - Eye of Anubis Hologram - Early Booster Pack Era

Starter Box Theatrical Release.title_en: Yu-Gi-Oh! OCG Starter Box - Theatrical Release
Starter Box Theatrical Release.title_jp: 遊戯王OCG スターターボックス 劇場版限定
Starter Box Theatrical Release.info: Starter Box: Theatrical Release is the first Starter Deck in the Yu-Gi-Oh! Official Card Game (OCG). It was released in theaters on March 6, 1999, coinciding with the Japanese premiere of Yu-Gi-Oh! (1999 film). The official, widespread release date was twelve days later, on March 18. In addition to the cards, it included a Deck box with belt clip, a Life Points calculator, six Star Chips, and a playmat.
Starter Box Theatrical Release.special_features: First Starter Deck - Theatrical Release Exclusive - Complete Deck Building Kit - Includes Accessories

Starter Box.title_jp: 遊戯王OCG スターターボックス
Starter Box.info: The Starter Box is the first official Starter Deck in the Yu-Gi-Oh! Official Card Game (OCG), released on March 18, 1999. In addition to the carefully curated cards for new players, both releases of the Starter Box included a Deck box with belt clip, a Life Points calculator, six Star Chips and a playmat—everything needed to begin playing the Yu-Gi-Oh! Trading Card Game.
Starter Box.special_features: First Starter Deck - Complete Gameplay Package - Includes Deck Box, Life Counter, Star Chips, Playmat
